title: Mistral CEO proposes a revenue-based levy for AI model providers in the EU, to be invested in "new content creation and supporting Europe's cultural sectors" (Arthur Mensch/Financial Times)
summary: Arthur Mensch / Financial Times: Mistral CEO proposes a revenue-based levy for AI model providers in the EU, to be invested in “new content creation and supporting Europe's cultural sectors” — A revenue-based charge would protect the livelihoods of copyright holders and bring legal certainty
